label: Add to Cart Button
purpose: Product add-to-cart button, optionally with prefix/suffix label icons
_notes: Real schema also has an 'atc_product'/'atc_skip_cart' pair to make this button add a DIFFERENT product to cart instead of the current product page's — omitted here since it needs a real product reference the AI can't supply; leaving it blank (the default) correctly adds the current product with its selected variant, quantity and upsells. prefix_icon/suffix_icon are small custom icon images shown before/after the button label (left empty by the AI per system prompt, filled by the image-generation step). All remaining real settings (button_style_secondary, large_font_size, custom colors, full_width, alignment, icon_scale/spacing, margins) are pure visual styling, omitted.
